title: What If All the Bees Vanished?

scenes.text: What if every bee vanished? The shocking part is what wouldn't change.
Wheat, rice and corn don't need bees. They use wind, so your bread and rice would stay.
But about thirty-five percent of the world's crop volume depends on pollinators. Seventy-five percent of crop types need them at least a little.
Apples, almonds, coffee and cocoa would shrink. Some, like Brazil nuts and cocoa, depend on pollinators almost entirely.
Overall, studies suggest production would fall around five to ten percent. A diet with less variety.
The real loss: wild plants. About eighty-seven percent of flowering plants rely on animals to reproduce.

description:
What if all the bees vanished?
Bread and rice would survive, but coffee, fruit, nuts and wild flowers would not.
What should we run through next?
